meta.title: Start, find, stop and restart stacks from the terminal: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: devhost start [names]
nodes.explanation: People and agents type devhost start [names] in a project folder; devhost finds the root manifest upward, or takes --manifest, as today (MAN-01). The first line names the stack, its checkout and its size: 'Starting Acme Shop from main ~/acme · 6 services' (SEL-4, FB-10). Against a running stack, names it left out start into it as the Services panel's Start does, with what they depend on: 'Started admin in Acme Shop · https://admin.shop.localhost/ · 1.2 s'; when all already run: 'Already running in Acme Shop: web, api' with their URLs only; during a stack-wide operation it refuses naming it and exits 1 (SEL-7, O6, CC-7, HOLD-3). With no manifest: 'No devhost.toml in ~/newapp or any folder above it', then devhost init on its own line and the Quickstart's URL; the Quickstart in devhost --help starts with the manifest, and devhost skill prints the guidance embedded in this binary, offline, naming devhost status, service, logs and reload (STATE-2, SURF-15, MENU-6, CC-11, CC-23; devhost init and the embedded skill are pending decisions, Backend 16). Resolves stack-run-stop-12 and stack-run-stop-01 (a start for a left-out service said only Already running).

sources.label: Reuses: manifest search upward to the root
Replaces: skill command that prints no skill
Replaces: Already running, names not compared

nodes.label: Detached status line
nodes.explanation: devhost start --detach names the stack within a second, 'Starting Acme Shop in the background from main ~/acme · 6 services', then keeps one status line updated on a terminal, 'Starting Acme Shop · 3 of 6 running · waiting for api · health check 2 s of 30 s · 7 s', or prints one line per change when output is not a terminal (FB-10, STATE-1, ACT-4). It ends with the same labelled URLs and ready line, 'Log: devhost logs' and, with an idle timeout, 'Stops after 30 min without requests (idleTimeout)' (ACT-10). Ctrl-C while it waits cancels: 'Cancelled the start of Acme Shop: stopped web and api, which had started', with no error tag (FAIL-5, KEY-14); a failure before readiness still stops what it started, as the owner intends, naming its cause once with its evidence (FAIL-1, FAIL-3). devhost logs [-f] [service…] reads the one log every stack writes per manifest, foreground included, whose name a replacement keeps: a header per run, timed lines, one format, failures marked ERR: as warnings are WARN: (FB-7, FB-11, CC-21, CC-23). Resolves stack-run-stop-04, stack-run-stop-05 and the log slice of agent-cli-journey-05.

sources.label: Replaces: blank wait, output only to the log
Replaces: Started line with unlabeled URLs
Replaces: a new log folder per replacement

nodes.label: Ready line and URLs
nodes.explanation: Each service's URL prints, labelled, as soon as its route is published ('api    https://shop.localhost/api/'), the primary service's first; then one ready line, 'Ready in 4.2 s: https://shop.localhost/ · 6 of 6 running', 'All stacks on this machine: https://devhost.localhost/' and, in a foreground terminal, 'Ctrl-C stops Acme Shop' (FB-10, WORD-4, SURF-15, KEY-14, CC-22). Ready is certified: it prints only once every started service passed its health check, with no leftover answering in its place (FB-5, ACT-11). A failed service is never offered as working: 'Ready in 4.6 s: https://shop.localhost/ · 5 of 6 running · api exited with code 1 at 14:01', then devhost service restart api on its own line (FAIL-1, MENU-6). Left-out services are counted, '4 of 6 running · 2 not started: admin, mail', a long list collapses to '34 services not started · devhost status', and the URL list never prints again after later actions (WORD-5, ACT-6). No URL, path or command breaks across lines, and URLs are OSC 8 links (WORD-8). Resolves stack-run-stop-03 with journey-crash-to-fix-05, stack-run-stop-10, and the start's slices of stack-directory-06 and proxy-settings-04.

sources.label: Replaces: URL list only after the slowest
Reuses: one line per URL, primary marked
Replaces: hard wrap inside URLs and paths

nodes.label: devhost service restart
nodes.explanation: devhost service start|stop|restart <service|group>… reach the running stack through its control server's recorded loopback port, as the toolbar does: each sends an operationId, waits for health checks with a progress line and prints one outcome per target, 'Restarted api · 2.6 s', 'Started admin and mail (admin depends on mail) · 3.1 s', 'Stopped worker · it reads not started, stopped by you'; a lost response is read from the operation record, never resent (SEL-7, MENU-1, MENU-6, REV-12, ACT-1, CC-11, CC-37). Another service's restart queues, 'worker queued behind Restart api'; during a stack-wide operation it refuses, 'Not restarted: Restart Stack is running · 3 of 6 started. Run it again when Restart Stack ends', exit 1 (HOLD-3, HOLD-1, CC-8). An external service: 'search runs outside devhost; devhost checks it but cannot restart it' (MENU-3, ACT-9). devhost service restart --all is Restart Stack's command: its statement first, no question, a per-service rollback on failure (a proposed REV-2 exception; UNDO-1). devhost reload [--dry-run] applies or checks the manifest on disk (FB-11, REV-10). Resolves agent-cli-journey-03; agent-cli-journey-02 is manifest-hot-reload's (related).

sources.label: Replaces: service command that only lists

nodes.label: devhost status
nodes.explanation: From any terminal or agent, devhost status [--json] [--wait] reads the published state and operation record every surface reads, never its own guess (FB-11, ACT-1, ACT-2, CC-23): 'Acme Shop · main ~/acme · PID 84244 · detached · failed · 4 of 6 running · 1 exited · 1 not started · as of 14:02:31' (ACT-6, ACT-12), then one line per service: state word, cause, since when, next command, 'api  exited with code 1 at 14:01 · devhost service restart api', an external service's check and time, a rejected file's line not applied, a blocked repository once (WORD-6, ACT-9, HOLD-6, HOLD-4), the last operation, 'Log: devhost logs' and the stack directory's URL. It exits 0 when every started service runs, 3 naming each that does not, 1 for its own failure; --json uses not-started and not-reachable (WORD-9). An unanswering control server reads 'its state is unknown, last seen 14:02', exit 1 (STATE-3, STATE-4). stack find resolves folders, . included, as devhost stop does; stack list on a terminal names each stack with its checkout and summary; piped, it keeps <PID><TAB><manifest path> (SEL-6, SEL-4, CC-34). Resolves agent-cli-journey-01, stack-run-stop-08 and stack-directory-06's list slice.

sources.label: Replaces: stack list of PID and path only
Replaces: substring match for a folder

nodes.label: Multi-stack set first
nodes.sublabel: asks only if a turn ends
nodes.explanation: devhost stop --worktrees and devhost stack replace --all print their set before acting: each stack's name, checkout label, PID, foreground or detached, and the conversations it would close, 'Acme Shop  fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav  PID 85102 · foreground · Claude Code working: "Fix the nav"' (SEL-6, SEL-4, FB-4). Only when the set would end an agent's turn that works or waits do they ask, on a terminal with CI unset: 'Stop 3 stacks and end Claude Code's working turn in fix-nav? [y/N]', where anything but y or yes stops nothing (REV-7, REV-4, O33). Without a terminal, or under AGENT=1, they refuse on one devhost: ERR: line telling the agent to ask the person, and exit 1 (REV-8, WORD-9). --yes acts without the question, and the documented upgrade step passes it; --dry-run prints the set and exits 0 (CC-12). --all lists serve sessions, which keep running (O31, CC-36). The set comes from the repository's worktree list, so a stack whose folder is gone is still classified, never by running Git in it, and another repository's stacks are never touched (REV-11, FAIL-2). Resolves stack-run-stop-07, stack-run-stop-16 and the conversations of chat-conversations-03.

Replaces: Git run in each stack's folder

nodes.label: Check, launch, certify
nodes.explanation: Before any service runs, devhost checks everything it can: the manifest and its includes against the schema, every service's cwd before the checkout lookup, the requested names, every hostname and fixed-port claim, and leftovers of an earlier, killed run of the same manifest (REV-11, ACT-11); any problem stops the start with nothing started. A manifest that starts but routes nothing the way it reads prints a warning with its location and keeps starting, 'devhost.toml:9:8  services.api.path  "/api" matches only the exact path /api; write "/api/*" to route everything under it', as does a path without host, which routes nothing; the ready line counts the warning and devhost status lists it (FAIL-2, MENU-4; the matching rule itself is a pending product decision, Backend 15). Services then launch in dependency order; a slow health check's waiting line keeps what the probe last saw, 'Waiting for api · GET /healthz returned 404 Not Found · 12 s of 30 s', and its failure says how to fix it (STATE-1, ACT-4, FAIL-3). Resolves journey-new-project-01 and journey-new-project-03; the 503 that scripts polling a starting service get is startup-and-recovery's (agent-cli-journey-04, related).

sources.label: Reuses: read, validate, check names first
Reuses: fixed port and hostname claims

nodes.label: One stop routine
nodes.explanation: devhost stop, Ctrl-C, stack replace, stop --worktrees and the Worktrees panel's Stop Stack share one routine (worktree-switch's conflict c5). It records why beside the stack's record before it signals, 'stopped from a terminal', so terminals, pages and hostnames can say so (ACT-10, HOLD-2). Services get SIGTERM in reverse dependency order and are waited for together, 10 s each, while one line names those still stopping: 'Stopping Acme Shop · 4 of 6 stopped · mail and worker still stopping · forced in 6 s · Ctrl-C forces them now' (FB-10, ACT-3, KEY-14). The caller waits up to O30's allowance, a minute plus 20 s per service, never killing the stack's devhost process while it still stops services; Ctrl-C while it waits, a second Ctrl-C in the stack's own terminal or a second devhost stop forces the rest within a second, signalling only verified process trees, and still releases routes, port claims and the record; a forced service reads 'Force-stopped worker after 10 s: it ignored SIGTERM' (ACT-11, FAIL-5, CC-35, CC-22). Resolves interrupted-operations-03; builds on the stopgaps of interrupted-operations-01 and process-containment-01 and on the stack-scale-01 patch (related).

sources.label: Replaces: waits one at a time, 10 s each
Replaces: 15 s, then SIGKILL of the supervisor
Replaces: a second Ctrl-C ignored

nodes.label: Replace devhost process
nodes.explanation: devhost stack replace, with stack restart as its alias, says replace in its help and output (O18, WORD-2, CC-31). Immediately before each signal it checks the stack's PID, start identity and root manifest, not its registration time, so a stack saved or hot reloaded meanwhile is still replaced, and one that stopped reads 'Acme Shop had already stopped; not replaced', never a failure (REV-13, FAIL-5). It waits for the old process's shutdown with the stop routine, up to O30's allowance, then starts the replacement from this executable with the same flags, checkouts and the services running at that moment, those started later included (SEL-7, CC-35), appending to the same log: 'Replaced Acme Shop's devhost process: PID 84244 → 85502 · 11 s · devhost 0.0.13'. A replaced foreground stack prints 'Replaced by devhost stack replace from another terminal at 14:02 · new PID 85502', then devhost logs -f and devhost stop on their own lines, and exits 0, never 143 (FAIL-5, CC-24); open pages reconnect to it and say so once (ACT-10). Resolves stack-run-stop-13, stack-run-stop-02 and stack-run-stop-15.

sources.label: Replaces: fixed 15 s wait, then relaunch
Replaces: registration time as identity

nodes.label: One line per operation
nodes.explanation: Every operation on the running stack, from any origin, prints one outcome line in its terminal and log, never the URL list again: 'Started admin · https://admin.shop.localhost/ · 1.2 s · from the toolbar' (FB-3, FB-7, FB-10, CC-22). Services devhost stops for an operation (Restart Stack, a switch, a hot reload, a shutdown) are its steps, never exits awaiting a restart, and a switch names both checkouts by label (FAIL-5, ACT-3, SEL-4). A service that exits names the command: 'api exited with code 1 at 14:01', then devhost service restart api (MENU-6, MENU-5). An exit from outside names its signal and sender: 'worker was terminated by SIGTERM (143) at 21:53:34, not sent by devhost' (FAIL-3, WORD-8, CC-24). A daemon that stops on its own prints one line, and one when it recovers; 'Acme Shop lost its proxy at 14:10 (devhost caddy stop); its services keep running', and one when its routes answer again (ACT-10); a devhost config file save prints its outcome and the stack directory's URL when it moves (SURF-15). Resolves the terminal slices of stack-scale-07, worktree-switch-04, interrupted-operations-04, manifest-hot-reload-2-02, notices-and-feedback-04 and proxy-settings-04.

sources.label: Replaces: every exit waits for a restart
Reuses: per-service stop lines

nodes.label: Stopped Acme Shop
nodes.explanation: The stop first names its target, never PIDs alone: 'Stopping Acme Shop (main ~/acme, PID 84244) · 6 services · closes 1 conversation: "Fix the nav" (Claude Code, working)'; it acts on the one stack it resolved and never asks (SEL-6, FB-4, REV-7). Success is certified only once no process, route or port claim of the stack remains: 'Stopped Acme Shop · 6 services · 6.1 s · closed "Fix the nav" (Claude Code, was working)' (FB-5, ACT-11, WORD-4). Processes cannot be un-stopped, so there is no Undo: the outcome names the way back, 'Start it again in ~/acme with:' and devhost start on its own line (UNDO-5); the closed conversation stays listed and resumes after the next start, from agent-chat's record (UNDO-4, O23). The stack's own terminal ends with 'Acme Shop stopped at 14:10: devhost stop from another terminal', and an open page's lost-connection notice reads 'Acme Shop stopped. Start it with devhost start in ~/acme' (ACT-10, HOLD-2). With nothing running it says 'Acme Shop is not running' (STATE-2); progress and outcome go to the streams reference/output.md names (WORD-9). Resolves chat-conversations-03's slice and stack-run-stop-06.

sources.label: Replaces: process(es) and PID lines
Replaces: Stack stopped. with no reason

nodes.label: Stopped-stack page
nodes.explanation: However a stack ends (devhost stop, Ctrl-C, the idle timeout, a replacement, killed, every service exited), its terminal and log print one line with the reason and time: 'Acme Shop stopped at 02:14 after 30 min without requests (idleTimeout)' (ACT-10, CC-27). For O15's time, 24 hours or until another stack claims the hostname or the shared Caddy stops, each of its hostnames answers a full status page instead of the generic 404: the heading 'Acme Shop stopped', that sentence, 'Start it again in ~/acme with' and devhost start with Copy, and All Stacks on This Machine, which lists it as recently stopped (STATE-2, STATE-3, UNDO-5, O15). It uses the shared status-page components and words, works without the toolbar, starts nothing and never opens a browser (SURF-14, WORD-6, O10). It fits 1600x1000, 1280x800 and 900x900 in both themes and 1280x800 at 200% zoom, and reflows at 320 px (SURF-9); Tab reaches Copy, then the link, and Copy keeps focus while the page's polite region says 'Copied devhost start' once (KEY-11, FB-9). It is the one browser surface this flow adds, in place of today's generic 404. Resolves stack-run-stop-11.

sources.label: Replaces: generic 404 naming no stack
Reuses: idle timeout shutdown

nodes.label: Start refused in place
nodes.explanation: Every problem prints at once, grouped by file relative to the root manifest, as file:line:column, key and message with the offending line and a close key: 'admin/devhost.toml:3:1  services.admin.hostname  unknown setting; did you mean host?', then 'Nothing started. Fix the manifest and run devhost start again' (FAIL-2, MENU-4, WORD-7, WORD-8). A hostname or port clash names every clash with the owning stack, its checkout and the command that stops it; an unknown name separates services from groups and suggests the closest. A missing cwd reads 'devhost.toml:12:7  services.api.cwd  folder api does not exist in ~/newapp', never a Git error (REV-11). Under AGENT=1 every problem joins one 'devhost: ERR:' line (FB-11, WORD-9). The person fixes the file and runs devhost start again; nothing was stopped or started, so nothing needs restoring. Resolves stack-run-stop-09 with its duplicate manifest-hot-reload-03 (the start's slice; reload rejections stay manifest-hot-reload's), journey-new-project-04 and the ERR: slice of agent-cli-journey-05.

Replaces: Git discovery before the cwd check
Replaces: ERR: on the first line only

nodes.label: Leftovers named, stopped
nodes.explanation: When a stack's devhost process died first (kill -9, a closed terminal, a crash), its record keeps each service's process group, start identity, ports and hostnames, and the next command that reads it finds what still runs (ACT-11). devhost status and stack list say 'Acme Shop is not running, but 2 services of its killed run still do: api (PID 8812, port 22310), worker (PID 8820)'. devhost start refuses before launching a service whose port or hostname a leftover holds: 'api's port 22310 is held by a leftover of Acme Shop's killed run: bun run src/server.ts (PID 8812, started 13:02)', then devhost stop on its own line, so a leftover is never reported ready (REV-11, FAIL-3). devhost stop there signals only processes whose start identity matches the record: 'Stopped 2 leftover services of Acme Shop's killed run: api and worker · 1.4 s' (FB-5). Resolves interrupted-operations-02; the identity it checks is the process-containment-01 stopgap's, and the interrupted-operations-01 stopgap keeps devhost stop from leaving leftovers (both related).

sources.label: Replaces: dead stack's records dropped silently
Replaces: TCP check passes on any listener

nodes.label: Each stack's own result
nodes.explanation: A stop that cannot certify its end names each survivor with its service, PID and port, 'Acme Shop is not fully stopped: worker (PID 8820, port 22314) still runs', and exits 1 (FAIL-1, ACT-11). A multi-stack command attempts every member and ends with one line per stack, 'Stopped Acme Shop (main ~/acme) · 4.1 s', 'Acme Shop (Detached 3f9c2a1 ~/review/acme) was not stopped: its devhost process (PID 85390) belongs to another user', and exits 1 naming each stack that still runs; one failure never ends the run (FAIL-1, SEL-4). A replacement whose shutdown outlasts the allowance is not left down without a word: 'Acme Shop was not replaced: worker (PID 8820) is still stopping after 3 min; nothing was started', then the command that starts it again, and exit 1 (FAIL-2, UNDO-5). The person runs the printed command; a second devhost stop forces what still stops (KEY-14). Resolves stack-run-stop-14 and the outcome half of stack-run-stop-13.

Replaces: SIGKILL that orphans the services

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: devhost stop's 'process(es)', 'Sending SIGTERM' and 'stopped cleanly' lines; its SIGKILL of the stack's devhost process after 15 s, which orphaned services while reporting success (the interrupted-operations-01 stopgap ships the never-kill part first); stack restart's fixed 15 s; a new restart-<random>/<PID>.log folder per replacement; 'devhost is waiting for a restart'; the generic 404 for a stack that just stopped; '[ERROR] received SIGINT' for a cancelled detached start; 'stack ownership changed; refresh worktrees' in a terminal; stop --worktrees ending at its first failure or on a missing folder; hard wrapping inside URLs, paths and commands; the URL list reprinted after every toolbar action

Merged: devhost stop, stack replace, stop --worktrees and the Worktrees panel's Stop Stack in one stop routine with one allowance, one progress line and one certified outcome; stack list and stack find on devhost stop's resolver

New: devhost status [--json] [--wait], devhost logs [-f] [--path], devhost reload [--dry-run] [--stdin], devhost service start|stop|restart and service restart --all; --dry-run and --yes on the multi-stack commands, with their question when a turn would end; the ready line, labelled URLs and the stack directory's URL; status lines for detached starts and stops; the stopped-stack record, page and end line; leftover detection; the probe's last status in health waits; devhost init and the embedded devhost skill (pending decisions); devhost stack replace with restart as its alias (O18)

Changed: start <names> starts left-out services into a running stack (O6, CC-7); stack find treats folders as folders (CC-34); a stop waits for the stack's own shutdown and certifies its end (CC-35); a replaced foreground stack exits 0 and says who replaced it (CC-24); --all leaves serve sessions running (O31, CC-36); a replacement keeps the services running at that moment (SEL-7); a foreground stack writes the per-manifest log (CC-21); agent output keeps the whole error on one ERR: line (CC-23, CC-30); the tests asserting today's lines change: services/stop_test.go, app/detach_test.go, services/detach_test.go, services/stack_test.go, app/run_test.go

Kept: the manifest found from any folder up to the repository root, and any path to it; validation and claims before any service runs, with nothing started on a refusal; a detached start waits for readiness, reuses a running stack, serializes concurrent starts and, on a failure before readiness, prints the log tail and stops what it started; the waiting line of a slow health check; a failed service leaves the rest running; every stop releases hostnames, ports and routes before it unregisters the stack; replace stops nothing when the executable is unavailable or the stack is its own ancestor, and re-checks identity before each signal; stop with nothing running says so; signals only to verified processes; the shared Caddy keeps running; --worktrees never touches another repository; two output contracts; devhost never opens a browser; idle shutdown as configured

items: CC-35: devhost stop waits for the stack's own shutdown, up to a minute plus 20 s per service, never kills its supervisor mid-stop and names survivors; Ctrl-C or a second stop forces the rest
CC-12: stop --worktrees and stack replace --all print their set, ask only when a turn would end, refuse elsewhere unless --yes, and take --dry-run
CC-31 (this flow's part, with O18): stack restart is documented as devhost stack replace and says replace; serve sessions keep running
CC-36: --all replaces every manifest stack, foreground ones included; serve sessions are listed and keep running
CC-24: a replaced foreground stack prints the new PID and log and exits 0
CC-21: every stack writes its per-manifest log, foreground included
CC-22: shutdown lines name slow and force-stopped services; the ready line; one outcome line per operation; URLs printed once
CC-23: devhost status, reload and logs; exit code 3; one ERR: line holding every issue
CC-11: devhost service start|stop|restart; [discuss]: --all for Restart Stack
CC-7, the terminal half: the selection changes while the stack runs
CC-34: stack find resolves folders as devhost stop does
CC-30: the two outputs report the same facts in their own layouts
CC-27: a recently stopped stack's hostnames and the stack directory name it
CC-32: the glossary's new terms, landed with this flow's terminal words
